boundary: IT is metered at the rack input (The Green Grid PUE category 3): a PUE measured at the UPS output would put the distribution stages inside IT
capex_note: capex on the final IT MW, bought in year 0 on every leg; boundary MV bus to rack input, the in-rack conversion inside

price.not_valued: demand, capacity, fixed and connection charges and tax or levy items are not valued: only the tariff's energy component prices the facility energy
price.real: held constant in real terms at the finance real rate

rms_caveat: An architecture's grid services are an assumed capability: an RMS study (EMT where the code asks) must show them before they count
second_order: assumed: the cooling of a variant's changed loss heat is not shifted, and each stage's efficiency is flat over part load

summary.cheapest_text: Cheapest over the horizon: not distinguishable on the assumed costs
